scripts.test: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd packages/database && DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" bunx drizzle-kit migrate && cd ../../ && DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" turbo run test --continue'
scripts.db:studio: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd packages/database && bunx drizzle-kit studio'
scripts.db:generate: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd packages/database && bunx drizzle-kit generate'
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd packages/database && bunx drizzle-kit migrate'
scripts.test:integration: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd packages/database && DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" bunx drizzle-kit migrate && cd ../../apps/api-service && DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" bun test src/__tests__/integration'
scripts.coverage:check: sh -c 'cd apps/api-service && bun run coverage:unit' && node scripts/check/coverage-threshold.mjs apps/api-service/coverage/lcov.info
scripts.coverage:check:client: sh -c 'cd apps/client && bun run coverage:unit' && COVERAGE_THRESHOLD=80 COVERAGE_TARGET="(^|/)features/[^/]+/(actions|queries)/" COVERAGE_LABEL="client actions/queries" node scripts/check/coverage-threshold.mjs apps/client/coverage/lcov.info
scripts.arch:deps: turbo run dep:cycles && turbo run dep:orphans
